summary: Project a real x-z wavevector from a nonnegative magnitude and angle, or compute magnitude from paired components already expressed in inverse metres.

identity.relation: Real x-z plane wavevector declaration to perpendicular and parallel components and magnitude
identity.direction: k and theta_rad -> kx, kz, k; or paired kx and kz -> kx, kz, k
identity.definition: Polar: kx = k sin(theta_rad), kz = k cos(theta_rad). Cartesian: k = hypot(kx, kz). The two input modes are exclusive.
identity.model: Euclidean wavevector geometry, without a dispersion or resonance model
identity.geometry: Background field along z; real wavevector in the x-z plane
identity.coordinates: Cartesian x-z components with z parallel to the background field
identity.boundary: Magnitude is nonnegative; zero magnitude keeps the supplied polar angle, whereas Cartesian mode returns no angle.
assumptions: The caller has converted source-specific wave numbers to consistent inverse-metre units.
The operation does not rotate coordinates or handle a y component.

inputs.name: k_grid
inputs.description: Wavevector magnitude sweep in polar mode.
inputs.constraints: Nonempty, one-dimensional, finite and nonnegative; exclusive with component grids.

inputs.name: theta_rad
inputs.description: Propagation angle from +z toward +x; ignored in Cartesian mode.
inputs.constraints: Defaults to zero in polar mode and must be finite there.

inputs.name: kx_grid
inputs.description: Perpendicular component sweep in Cartesian mode.
inputs.constraints: Requires a same-length kz_grid; exclusive with k_grid.

inputs.name: kz_grid
inputs.description: Parallel component sweep in Cartesian mode.
inputs.constraints: Requires a same-length kx_grid; exclusive with k_grid.

outputs.name: theta_rad
outputs.description: Declared polar angle or null in Cartesian mode.

preconditions: Caller has already converted all wave numbers to 1/m.
Arrays are finite real vectors; paired components have equal length.
supported: Single-angle polar sweeps and paired Cartesian component sweeps in the x-z plane.
excluded: PDRK scan selection, logarithmic controls, par state updates and derived angle output.
Complex wavevectors, y components, coordinate rotations and dispersion physics.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for missing or mixed modes, non-real or nonfinite vectors, negative polar magnitude, non-real or nonfinite polar angle, invalid component shape, or nonfinite computed Cartesian magnitude.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unexpected NumPy execution errors propagate; malformed numeric input is rejected as invalid input.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; there is no iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; the result dictionary is returned only after validation and calculation complete.

provenance.lineage_summary: Development integration from the saved PDRF planar projection and bounded comparison with the overlapping PDRK scan relation. Later whole-source review withdrew both projects' former strict D1 qualification: PDRF's public SI output/reassembly denominator remains open, while PDRK has additional executable source paths requiring disposition. Both retained candidates support bounded historical development comparison only, not current qualified L1 provenance or SciRel expert recognition. The source-package digests and port mapping remain in the intake evaluation.
source_kinds: saved L1 operator documents and implementations

example.description: Measure a 3-4-5 Cartesian wavevector after caller-side SI conversion.
example.code:
from scirel.geometry import project_planar_wavevector
result = project_planar_wavevector(kx_grid=[3.0], kz_grid=[4.0])
assert result['k'][0] == 5.0
example.expected: kx=[3], kz=[4], k=[5] in 1/m, with theta_rad=None.

scope: Non-real input rejection, nonfinite magnitude rejection and large finite hypot behavior.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Source-free direct tests establish this development callable's declared bounded arithmetic and failures. Saved PDRF and PDRK implementations support only historical bounded comparisons on the tested mapped domain; neither project currently has a qualified strict D1 delivery. These comparisons do not establish complete source-project reproduction, physical validity or SciRel expert approval of this standardized relation.
known_limitations: PDRF normalized input-card wave numbers lack a verified conversion to 1/m.
SciRel rejects string/boolean numeric surrogates; the source comparison covers only the declared real numeric domain.
Cartesian hypot intentionally differs from the PDRF square-and-sum overflow at large finite components.
PDRK scan-state semantics require a separate relation.
SciRel expert recognition and distribution licensing remain pending.
